title: Causal Identification under Interference: The Role of Treatment Assignment Independence
abstract: arXiv:2604.22532v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Applied researchers often use identification formulas derived under individualistic treatment response (ITR), which rules out interference, even when interference is plausible but unobserved. We characterize what these identification formulas recover under arbitrary interference. For selection on observables, instrumental variables, sharp regression discontinuity, and difference-in-differences, each ITR-based formula equals an average direct effect (ADE)-type estimand plus a bias. Every term of the bias is the product of an interference component and a component measuring how the law of others' assignments differs across the two comparison groups. The bias therefore vanishes under a restriction on the assignment mechanism, generalized conditional assignment independence (CAI), whose design-specific forms include conditions used in the literature. translated_title: 干扰效应下的因果识别：处理分配独立性的作用
translated_abstract: 应用研究者经常使用在个体化处理响应（ITR）假设下推导的识别公式，该假设排除了干扰效应，即使在干扰可能存在但未被观测到的情况下也是如此。我们刻画了这些识别公式在任意干扰下所能恢复的估计量。对于基于可观测变量的选择、工具变量、精确断点回归和双重差分这几种设计，每个基于ITR的公式都等于一个平均直接效应（ADE）类型的估计量加上一个偏差项。偏差的每一项都是一个干扰成分与一个衡量他者分配规律在两个比较组之间差异程度的成分的乘积。因此，在分配机制的一个限制条件——广义条件分配独立性（CAI）下，偏差会消失，该条件针对不同研究设计的具体形式涵盖了文献中已使用的各种条件。由于广义CAI通常无法从分配结果的单一实现中加以检验……
tldr: 本文刻画了在存在干扰效应时，基于个体化处理响应假设的各类因果识别公式实际恢复的是“平均直接效应估计量加偏差项”，并证明偏差在满足广义条件分配独立性这一分配机制约束时会消失。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes what ITR-based identification formulas recover under arbitrary interference—each equals an average direct effect estimand plus a bias that vanishes under generalized conditional assignment independence of the treatment assignment mechanism.
